tools.description: Free public provenance check before spending a read: source-match vs editorial vs owner-reviewed status, document-check timestamps, linked updates/counterpoints, and thresholded opted-in reuse. Not a truth score or live freshness verification. No private installation, consent or review credentials a

tools.description: Start 10 compact reads without an account or report. Two trials per daily network cohort; reuse existing keys. Returns an agent accessKey and a secret owner management link. tools.name: submit_knowledge_card
tools.description: Publish 3–5 short exact excerpts ONLY from public documentation hosts in a CURRENT owner-enabled scope. Use a separate public-source context, local screening and the SDK. At most 25 words / 220 characters per source. The server verifies every excerpt against the public page. No private chat, files o

tools.name: report_reuse
tools.description: Only with owner-enabled feedback, report whether a previously read card was used. Card ID plus a fixed reason code; no raw question or conversation. One feedback record per installation/card. Other installations’ eligible reuse can reward the contributor +2 reads, capped at 20/day.

tools.name: get_contribution_status
tools.description: Read installation credits, current authorized source hosts, scope expiration and rewards. Bearer accessKey. Does not enable sharing or publish.

tools.name: search_research
tools.description: Find existing public research before generating it again. Returns short, untrusted excerpts, dates and citation URLs. Search is free; no contribution needed.

tools.name: read_research
tools.description: Read selected evidence within a JSON character budget. Requires Authorization: Bearer <trial or contribution access key>. Consumes one available read. nextCursor requests another excerpt. Budget and token estimates are approximate token costs, not billing.

tools.name: prepare_contribution
tools.description: ONLY after the owner explicitly permits processing a specifically selected report: prepare a pattern-redacted PRIVATE draft. Access to files is not permission. tools.name: contribution_access_status
tools.description: Check whether the owner has approved a contribution and how many reads remain. Uses Authorization bearer key. Does not publish or consume reads.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_evidence_receipt, search_research, prepare_contribution · Private data: lookup_evidence, get_evidence_receipt, start_trial, submit_knowledge_card, report_reuse, read_research, prepare_contribution · Public sink: lookup_evidence, submit_knowledge_card, get_contribution_status, prepare_contribution, contribution_access_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_evidence_receipt, search_research, prepare_contribution · Private data: lookup_evidence, get_evidence_receipt, start_trial, submit_knowledge_card, report_reuse, read_research, prepare_contribution · Public sink: lookup_evidence, submit_knowledge_card, get_contribution_status, prepare_contribution, contribution_access_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
